title: One of the toys destroyed in an hour
text: We have two 50+ lbs yellow lab mixes. They like the treats and the toys; but my male dog destroyed one of the toys in an hour. The other toy seams much more durable and is doing fine. He does like to chew and make toys squeak, but we hoe other toys that have lasted months. Cost is much too high if toy only last an hour. I canceled the subscription
label: neutral
